summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Wizard Empresa regressions. All 5 features tested and verified working correctly: 1) Mista + Lucro Presumido shows TWO presunção fields, 2) AI keyword generation works, 3) Restaurante fills with 'TODOS OS PRODUTOS', 4) Casa de Carnes fills with carnes frescas only (no bacon/embutidos), 5) Simples Nacional shows suggested anexos based on CNAEs.
passed_tests: Feature 1: Mista + Lucro Presumido shows TWO presunção fields (Comércio/Indústria 8% and Serviços 32%)
Feature 2: AI keyword generation via 'Gerar Palavras-Chave Automaticamente' button works - fills Revenda, Insumos, Despesas fields
Feature 3: Restaurante icon (btn-estab-restaurante) fills produtos_sem_credito_icms with 'TODOS OS PRODUTOS'

Feature 4: Casa de Carnes icon (btn-estab-casa_carnes) fills with carnes frescas only (carne, bovina, suina, frango, peixe, picanha, alcatra, costela, file, corte, ave) - does NOT include bacon, linguica, presunto, mortadela, frios, embutidos
Feature 5: Simples Nacional shows 'Sugeridos com base nos CNAEs' with auto-selected anexos (I, II, III based on company CNAEs)
Wizard navigation through all 6 steps works correctly
CNPJ search fetches company data from Receita Federal
SINTEGRA integration for Inscrição Estadual works
Establishment type icons all have correct data-testid attributes (btn-estab-restaurante, btn-estab-casa_carnes, etc.)
critical_code_review_comments: WizardEmpresa.js correctly implements conditional rendering for Mista + Lucro Presumido (lines 1270-1323)
TIPOS_ESTABELECIMENTO_BENEFICIO array correctly defines palavras_excluir for each establishment type
Restaurante correctly uses ['TODOS OS PRODUTOS'] for complete ICMS credit exclusion
Casa de Carnes correctly excludes bacon, linguica, presunto, mortadela, frios, embutidos from the list
sugerirAnexosPorCnaes function correctly suggests anexos based on CNAE prefixes
